reading.body:
Digital Realty's DFW18 in Richardson is a 464,500 square foot facility with 2N+1 cooling redundancy, but no power capacity is published. Without a megawatt figure, its size in the AI compute hierarchy cannot be calculated from the data provided.

Texas has 133 mapped data center facilities, of which only 18 publish power capacity totaling 468 megawatts. This campus ranks 19th by published megawatts in the state, a ranking that reflects the incompleteness of disclosure: most facilities, including this one, do not publish the power figure needed to assess their relevance to AI scaling.

The DFW18 facility sits within Digital Realty's Dallas-Fort Worth campus cluster in Richardson, which includes at least three named buildings. Whether this campus matters to AI depends on data the operator has not released: the megawatt capacity, the power density of its customer workloads, and the grid's headroom to serve it. These facts are not published.
